symtropy.boundary: Runs explicitly versioned physical scenarios; outputs stay modelled until independently calibrated and validated against appropriate observations.

sol_atlas.boundary: Maps scenarios, boundaries, uncertainty, distributions, and provenance; does not convert a visual layer into evidence or approval.
